panels.description: bam_enabled is a boolean operator toggle: 1 when BAM is enabled, 0 when disabled. The panel takes the max across the selected instance(s) to show whether BAM is enabled anywhere.
panels.title: BAM Enabled

panels.description: Current BAM client health (bam_healthy). Max across the selected instance(s) returns 1 when at least one BAM client is fully connected, authenticated, configured, and heartbeat healthy, 0 when none are.
panels.title: BAM Healthy

panels.description: bam_healthy is a boolean gauge: 1 when the BAM client is fully connected, authenticated, configured, and heartbeat healthy, 0 otherwise. This panel uses min_over_time over $__rate_interval so any unhealthy sample marks the interval as 0.
panels.title: BAM Health Timeline

panels.description: Healthy connection lifecycle and keepalive acknowledgment activity. bam_healthy_connects and bam_healthy_disconnects count transitions into and out of CONNECTED_HEALTHY; bam_keepalive_acks counts HTTP/2 keepalive PING acknowledgments received from the BAM node.
panels.title: BAM Healthy Connects and Keepalive ACKs

panels.description: Heartbeat exchange with the BAM node. bam_validator_heartbeats_enqueued counts validator heartbeat messages accepted by gRPC stream_send; bam_builder_heartbeats_decoded counts builder heartbeat messages successfully decoded, shown as rates.
panels.title: BAM Heartbeats

panels.description: HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time in nanoseconds. bam_keepalive_rtt_sample is the latest sample, bam_keepalive_rtt_smoothed is the exponentially smoothed estimate, and bam_keepalive_rtt_deviation is the smoothed RTT variation estimate.
panels.title: BAM Keepalive RTT

panels.description: Per-second publish rate from BAM into verify. bam_transaction_published counts transactions published from BAM, including those unpacked from bundles, and bam_atomic_batch_published counts revert_on_error AtomicTxnBatch entries published into the pipeline.
panels.title: BAM Publish Rate

panels.description: Current number of BAM feedback results buffered for send (bam_feedback_queue_depth gauge). A rising value indicates feedback is falling behind.
panels.title: BAM Feedback Queue Depth

panels.description: Bundle backlog in pack. pack_available_transactions with avail_txn_type=bundles is the count of pending bundle transactions available to schedule; pack_pending_transactions_heap_size is the fixed capacity of pack's pending heap.
panels.title: Pack Bundle Backlog

panels.description: BAM tile workspace heap usage in bytes. bam_heap_size is total reserved capacity, bam_heap_free_bytes is estimated free space, and used is computed as size minus free.
panels.title: BAM Heap Usage

panels.description: Relative BAM node heartbeat latency distribution, computed from the heartbeat timestamp to Frankendancer scheduler-stream receive callback time.
panels.title: BAM Node Heartbeat Network Latency

panels.description: Scheduler Ping to Pong response-latency distribution inside the BAM client, measured from Ping receive callback to successful Pong send completion.
panels.title: BAM Scheduler Ping Response Delay

panels.description: Drop rates from BAM ingest and feedback. bam_ingress_packet_oversize counts BAM packets rejected because their declared payload exceeded the local MTU; bam_feedback_results_dropped counts feedback results dropped because the local result queue was full.
panels.title: BAM Drops

panels.description: Per-second BAM client failure rates grouped by bam_failure. bam_failure is a cumulative counter with disjoint decode, request_failed, transport, unsupported_version, and timeout buckets.
panels.title: BAM Failures (by class)

panels.description: Per-second bundle-related transaction failures through verify/dedup/resolv plus pack drops. verify/dedup/resolv metrics count transactions that failed because a peer in the same bundle failed; pack_transaction_dropped_partial_bundle counts transactions dropped in pack because the bundle was partial. Failures are per-transaction even when the root cause is a bundle.
panels.title: Pipeline Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: Per-second rate of bank execution results labeled transaction_error=bundle_peer. These are transactions that failed because a peer transaction in the same bundle failed (bank_transaction_result counter).
panels.title: Bank Bundle Peer Failures

panels.description: Per-second results of pack's bundle crank checks, grouped by bundle_crank_result: not_needed (on-chain state already correct), inserted (initializer bundle inserted), creation_failed, and insertion_failed.
panels.title: Bundle Crank Status

panels.description: Delay in starting the slot caused by loading data needed for bundle crank transactions.
panels.title: PoH Bundle Init Delay

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of decoded multiple_atomic_txn_batch scheduler payloads. Builder-heartbeat traffic is shown in the dedicated BAM Heartbeats panel, so this panel isolates work-carrying ingress messages.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Work Messages

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) through BAM ingress batch lifecycle: commit attempts, published entries, and total rejected entries. Rejections are the sum of the disjoint bam_ingress_batch_rejected reason buckets.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Batch Lifecycle

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM ingress rejects by reason, grouped by bam_ingress_batch_reject_reason. The buckets are disjoint and cover invalid_batch, empty_batch, vote_transaction, non_revert_multi_packet, empty_message, and overflow_message.
panels.title: BAM Ingress Reject Reasons

panels.description: Total scheduler-stream live-state transitions over the selected time range, grouped by bam_stream_transition. down_to_live and live_to_down should usually remain close.
panels.title: BAM Stream Transitions (Range Count)

panels.description: Total pending leader-state updates cleared or superseded before send over the selected time range, grouped by bam_leader_pending_drop_reason. Healthy steady state is typically near zero; superseded indicates a newer pending leader-state replaced an older unsent one.
panels.title: BAM Leader Pending Clears (Range Count)

panels.description: Successful BAM outbound sends over the selected time range, split by leader-state updates and bundle-result messages.
panels.title: BAM Successful Enqueues (Range Count)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM outbound enqueue outcomes, grouped by bam_enqueue_outcome on bam_outbound_enqueue_outcome. The `leader_state_enqueued` and `result_enqueued` buckets are the successful gRPC stream_send accepts; no_stream/enqueue_fail indicate skipped or failed enqueue attempts.
panels.title: BAM Enqueue Outcomes

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM scheduler stream live-state transitions, using bam_stream_transition.
panels.title: BAM Stream Transitions

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of pending BAM leader-state updates dropped before send, using bam_leader_pending_dropped.
panels.title: BAM Pending Leader Drops

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of in-progress BAM bundle assembly abandonment in pack, grouped by pack_bam_bundle_assembly_abandon_reason (new sequence preemption, slot-end transitions, or PoH timeout).
panels.title: Pack BAM Bundle Assembly Abandon (by reason)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM work invalidated by slot/blockhash revalidation in pack, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason across single transactions and fully assembled bundles. This is the superset counter: it includes both pre-pending rejects and post-acceptance evictions.
panels.title: Pack BAM Work Invalidated (superset, by reason)

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM pending-work items that were accepted into pack, remained in the pending-work tracker, and were later evicted by slot/blockhash revalidation, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason. This is the post-acceptance subset of pack_bam_work_invalidated.
panels.title: Pack BAM Pending Work Evicted (post-acceptance, by reason)

panels.description: Current count of BAM work items that have been accepted into pack and are still tracked in pack's pending-work set, before schedule handoff or cleanup.
panels.title: Pack BAM Pending Work Count

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of BAM transactions or fully assembled BAM bundles rejected by slot/blockhash revalidation before they were ever accepted into pack's pending-work tracker, grouped by pack_bam_work_invalid_reason.
panels.title: Pack BAM Rejected Pre-Pending (by reason)

panels.description: Current BAM freshness state for the active slot. bam_current_slot_fresh is 1 while the local leader slot is still open and pack has already accepted at least one current-slot BAM work item before slot end; otherwise 0.
panels.title: BAM Current Slot Fresh

panels.description: Rate (events/sec) of leader slots that ended while BAM healthy override remained active but no current-slot BAM work was accepted before slot end.
panels.title: BAM Override Without Fresh Work

panels.description: Instantaneous signed nanosecond delta from first BAM ingress to slot end for the highest resolved slot currently present in the BAM slot-ingress timing ring. Positive means ingress was after slot end.

targets.expr: topk by (instance, kind, kind_id) (1, bam_slot_ingress_timing_slot{instance=~"$instance"} * bam_slot_ingress_timing_valid{instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance, kind, kind_id, bam_slot_ingress_timing_idx) group_left() (bam_slot_ingress_timing_first_rx_minus_slot_end_ns{instance=~"$instance"} * bam_slot_ingress_timing_first_rx_minus_slot_end_valid{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Latest BAM Ingress vs Slot End

panels.description: Instantaneous signed nanosecond delta from first BAM acceptance into pack to slot end for the highest leader slot currently present in pack's recent-slot timing ring. Positive means pack first accepted BAM work after slot end.

targets.expr: topk by (instance, kind, kind_id) (1, pack_bam_recent_slot_slot{instance=~"$instance"} * pack_bam_recent_slot_valid{instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance, kind, kind_id, pack_bam_recent_slot_idx) group_left() (pack_bam_first_insert_minus_slot_end_ns{instance=~"$instance"} * pack_bam_first_insert_recorded{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Latest Pack Insert vs Slot End

panels.description: Instantaneous signed nanosecond delta from first BAM schedule handoff to slot end for the highest leader slot currently present in pack's recent-slot timing ring. Positive means pack first scheduled BAM work after slot end.

targets.expr: topk by (instance, kind, kind_id) (1, pack_bam_recent_slot_slot{instance=~"$instance"} * pack_bam_recent_slot_valid{instance=~"$instance"}) * on(instance, kind, kind_id, pack_bam_recent_slot_idx) group_left() (pack_bam_first_schedule_minus_slot_end_ns{instance=~"$instance"} * pack_bam_first_schedule_recorded{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Latest Pack Schedule vs Slot End
